reviews.raw:
{
  "verdict": "APPROVED",
  "summary": "Implementation of PLAN-B73 strictly adheres to the approved specifications. Candidate conditions F1–F9 are computed identically across research and live scanning with no look-ahead bias and low memory overhead (avoiding large pivot tables). The B1/B2 statistical tests and bootstrap procedures match the plan. Frontend properly respects the research outcome (pooled score failed, S10 passed B1 filter combo F8+F9), displaying the filter recommendation and sorting matching stocks to the top without hiding non-matching items. Fallback handling, XSS escaping, and backward compatibility for existing scan results are fully covered.",
  "findings": [],
  "coverage": "Inspected quality.py (stock metrics, cross-sectional thresholds, live_table, annotate), run_quality.py (B1 45 combinations search, monthly block bootstrap, BH correction, B2 pooled score), py.diff (server endpoint /api/quality/research, yahoo_price scan hook), and front.diff (quality-card, strategy research view, table header/row injection, sorting and tooltip escaping).",
  "limitations": "Review was static code inspection and diff verification against PLAN-B73 requirements and operational constraints without executing live database queries on the local machine."
}

parsed.summary: Implementation of PLAN-B73 strictly adheres to the approved specifications. Candidate conditions F1–F9 are computed identically across research and live scanning with no look-ahead bias and low memory overhead (avoiding large pivot tables). The B1/B2 statistical tests and bootstrap procedures match the plan. Frontend properly respects the research outcome (pooled score failed, S10 passed B1 filter combo F8+F9), displaying the filter recommendation and sorting matching stocks to the top without hiding non-matching items. Fallback handling, XSS escaping, and backward compatibility for existing scan results are fully covered.
parsed.coverage: Inspected quality.py (stock metrics, cross-sectional thresholds, live_table, annotate), run_quality.py (B1 45 combinations search, monthly block bootstrap, BH correction, B2 pooled score), py.diff (server endpoint /api/quality/research, yahoo_price scan hook), and front.diff (quality-card, strategy research view, table header/row injection, sorting and tooltip escaping).
parsed.limitations: Review was static code inspection and diff verification against PLAN-B73 requirements and operational constraints without executing live database queries on the local machine.
